title: Wang Yun Lays the Chain Stratagem; Dong Zhuo Storms out of the Phoenix Pavilion
summary: Wang Yun, weeping alone in his garden at the state of the empire, finds his singing-girl Diaochan weeping too, and asks her to do a thing no army has managed.

He promises her to Lü Bu and then presents her to Dong Zhuo, and lets each of them find out. She plays them against each other with complete composure — a look here, a tear there — until Lü Bu, hidden in the Phoenix Pavilion, sees what he takes for proof, and Dong Zhuo hurls a halberd at his head.
history: Diaochan is fictional. The histories record only that Lü Bu had an affair with one of Dong Zhuo's maids and lived in fear of being found out — which was enough for Wang Yun to work with.

pins.note: Sets the chain stratagem in motion.
Promised to Lü Bu, given to Dong Zhuo.
Between the capital and his treasure fortress.
